scope: Partial physical alignment checks; not full library or variant coverage
method: Generate native PCB through GUI engine, export STEP including pads using kicad-cli, compare FreeCAD solid geometry

ceoloide/power_switch_smd_side.xy: Each terminal solid lies within exactly one exported copper pad

ceoloide/diode_tht_sod123.xy: Each terminal solid lies within exactly one exported copper pad
ceoloide/diode_tht_sod123.polarity: Cathode marking solid remains toward pad 1 (to net)

ceoloide/battery_connector_molex_pico_ez.geometry: Both signal pads have a nonzero solid intersection with the socket contact geometry after KiCad STEP export

ceoloide/led_sk6812mini-e.geometry: Each lead projection intersects exactly one copper pad; marked pin 3 matches GND

ceoloide/trrs_pj320a.geometry: Four leg solids fit four distinct drilled slots and span the board thickness
ceoloide/trrs_pj320a.signals: SL, R2, TP and R1 match footprint pad numbers; symmetric layout joins R1 to TP as authored upstream

ceoloide/display_ssd1306.geometry: Four socket mounting shafts fit their four 1 mm PCB drills
ceoloide/display_ssd1306.pinOrder: Model etched labels SDA/SCK/VCC/GND match SDA/SCL/VCC/GND front pin order; B orientation mirrors it

ceoloide/reset_switch_smd_side.geometry: Four contact projections intersect the copper pads; both locating bosses fit their 0.75 mm NPTH holes when enabled
ceoloide/reset_switch_smd_side.selection: include_bosses selects the matching default; custom filenames remain authoritative

ceoloide/battery_connector_jst_ph_2.xy: Two straight entry shafts fit separate 0.75 mm holes; housing is centered on footprint
ceoloide/battery_connector_jst_ph_2.limitation: Unloaded retention bends are not rigid-fit gauges. Physical insertion and PCB drill process remain unverified.

ceoloide/mcu_nice_nano.xy: All 24 module holes coincide with PCB socket holes after correcting the model row datum
ceoloide/mcu_nice_nano.orientation: MCU package faces toward or away from PCB according to reverse_mount
ceoloide/mcu_nice_nano.limitation: Socket/header solids and optional extra pins are not covered by these checks
